text: Clean telemetry is sitting in S3, but nobody writes a bill by querying Parquet files. This video brings it into Redshift as two real business tables.

Redshift Spectrum reads the curated data straight through the same Glue catalog. installation_performance_gold tracks daily kWh and panel health; monthly_billing_gold rolls that up into each member's monthly net-metering credit.
The daily table derives a health flag from the worst status code seen that day, loaded with a delete-then-insert so a re-run never double counts a day's generation.
Monthly billing applies one board-approved rate, $0.1125 per kWh, to that month's total generation -- the same calculation, every installation, every month.
The two numbers that matter most -- performance and billing -- now live in Redshift. Next: running this entire pipeline automatically, every night.
